How it works

Starting…

Three steps, no sign-up

Paste

Copy the share link from the app and drop it in the box. The app name on screen switches on its own.

Choose

Pick video quality, audio only or a photo from Select format.

Save

Watch the progress bar fill, then the file lands in your downloads.

About WhatsApp status

WhatsApp statuses don't have public links, so a link box can't fetch them. To keep a status someone shared with you, ask them to send it to you, or open it in WhatsApp and use the built-in forward or save option. Your own statuses are already stored in your phone's gallery.

Only save content you own, that is licensed for reuse, or that you have the creator's permission to download. Respect each platform's terms and the creator's copyright.
